purpose: exploratory local reoptimization of the existing five-segment pulse against the final P0-4 numerical-reference model

metric_definition.reported_fidelity: loss-aware average computational-basis CZ overlap from the non-Hermitian no-jump return diagonal, with lost norm counted as orthogonal erasure
metric_definition.local_z: one nominal correction calibrated separately for each pulse and propagation resolution, then fixed over its geometry/amplitude set
metric_definition.objective: max(1-F) + 0.02*mean(1-F) over the eight axial-endpoint/independent-amplitude vertices plus nominal
metric_definition.conditional_no_jump_diagnostic: loss-aware overlap divided by mean computational survival; a postselected diagnostic, not a CPTP process fidelity
metric_definition.cptp_scope: state-resolved jump branches are not modeled, so neither the loss-aware overlap nor the conditional diagnostic is a reconstructed CPTP process fidelity

claim_limitations.task_scope: theory-paper numerical reoptimization, not experimental validation
claim_limitations.decay: zero-temperature lifetime-weighted non-Hermitian no-jump attenuation; state-resolved jump destinations omitted
claim_limitations.rb_excitation: effective two-level 5 MHz pi pulse; intermediate-state scattering omitted
claim_limitations.position_domain: bounded static relative displacement ball of radius 50 nm
claim_limitations.amplitude_domain: only the four independent +/-1% Rabi vertices
claim_limitations.transverse_geometry: angle-dependent Delta-M=0 tensor term retained; Delta-M=+/-1,+/-2 terms omitted for the sampled sub-degree tilts, as in the existing model
claim_limitations.exploratory_status: deterministic accepted local candidate; the optimizer exhausted its budget and did not report convergence; no global optimum is claimed

stage_1.varied_parameters: six amplitudes/detunings at fixed common segment duration
stage_1.message: Maximum number of iterations has been exceeded.

optimization.stopping_condition: stage 1 reached its recorded optimizer termination; exact validation then crossed nominal 0.999, so stage 2 was not triggered
